[[Warrior Deldrimor armor]] is the collective name used to refer to the stand alone armor pieces crafted for warriors by [[Gobrech Stonefoot]] in [[Central Transfer Chamber]]. It is also sometimes referred to as Dwarven armor.

It is made up of the following pieces:
*[[Warrior Heavy Breastplate|Heavy Breastplate]]
*[[Warrior Ironfist Gauntlets|Ironfist Gauntlets]]
*[[Warrior Stalwart Leggings|Stalwart Leggings]]
*[[Warrior Sturdy Boots|Sturdy Boots]]

The total cost for all pieces would be 350{{iron}}, 35{{Deldrimor Steel}} and 40{{plat}}
